added.description:
Requisition Number: 77782

The company built on breakthroughs.   

Join us.  

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.    

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.   

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.   

Come break through with us. 

Corning’s Environmental Technologies segment manufactures ceramic substrates and filter products for emissions control in mobile and stationary applications around the world.

Role Purpose

Corning Environmental Technologies is seeking a Department Head of Die Manufacturing to lead the die manufacturing operations that produce the extrusion die tooling at the heart of our ceramic substrate and particulate filter products. Operating in a machine shop / high-precision machining / chemical manufacturing environment, this leader owns the manufacturing engineering strategy, execution, and organizational capability of a die operation that is mission-critical to Corning's global CET manufacturing network. While the role carries single-site authority, its output directly enables product quality, capacity, and launch readiness across CET plants worldwide. This is fundamentally a run-and-improve leadership role: making a critical, complex operation faster, higher-quality, more cost-effective, and more capable, while building the bench strength of the engineering and technician teams beneath you. Success requires strong manufacturing engineering leadership first, forming/extrusion tooling insight second, focus on customer satisfaction, and process knowledge as a valuable complement.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the die manufacturing engineering department’s daily operations and long-term strategy within a high-precision machining and chemical manufacturing environment. Oversee managers, engineers, and technicians to improve die quality, reduce correction cycles, lower lead times and costs, and ensure designs meet customer and production needs.
Drive customer satisfaction by partnering with forming sites and cross-functional teams across the global CET network to solve problems and align on priorities. Support divisional growth by advancing capacity, capability, automation, Lean initiatives, and engineering excellence standards.
Develop team capability through coaching, succession planning, and organizational growth while maintaining strong operational discipline through metrics, safety, quality standards, and data-driven decision-making.
Success in the first 12–18 months includes measurable improvements in die yield and first-pass quality, reduced lead time and cost, progress in automation and capability expansion, stronger customer satisfaction, and deeper team capability and succession strength.

Experiences/Education - Required

BS in Engineering (Mechanical, Manufacturing, Ceramic, Industrial, or related discipline).
8+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
Proven people-leadership experience — manager-of-managers preferred; a strong single-layer manager ready to step up will be considered.
Track record of leading manufacturing engineering in a precision machining, tooling, chemical manufacturing, or job-shop environment.
Demonstrated ability to drive quality, cost, delivery, and continuous-improvement results through teams.

Experiences/Education - Desired

Experience in forming and extrusion tooling, ideally in ceramic honeycomb substrate manufacturing or a comparable precision extrusion die manufacturing environment, with working knowledge of CNC, EDM, die design (CAD/CAM), and precision finishing processes.
Strong background in PCPD (Product/Process Commercialization & Development) or a similar stage-gate discipline, along with fluency in Lean, structured problem-solving methodologies, and Engineering Excellence practices and standards.
Advanced technical foundation, including an MS in Engineering or a related field.
Proven leadership competencies in cross-functional influence across a global matrix without direct authority, talent development and succession building, driving change through Lean and continuous improvement, and making disciplined, data-driven decisions grounded in metrics, root-cause analysis, and operational rigor.

This position does not support immigration sponsorship.

The range for this position is $136,243.00 - $187,335.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.

A national workforce development organization dedicated to connecting skilled, work-authorized professionals to career-aligned employment across the United States is seeking a VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure. The organization focuses on creating economic opportunity, scaling programmatic impact, and leveraging modern technology and artificial intelligence to drive operational efficiency and positive participant outcomes.

Role Overview

The VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure is responsible for defining and executing the organization’s technology strategy and infrastructure across internal operations and externally facing digital products. Reporting to the President and working closely with the CEO and executive leadership, this leader guides the organization toward an AI- and product-first model while upholding operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. This role operates in a full-time, remote capacity within the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Own the overarching technology strategy across staff infrastructure and external user- and partner-facing products, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and mission-aligned.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap encompassing staff infrastructure, IT operations, data systems and reporting, platform evolution, core digital products, and system integrations.
Translate organizational strategy into sequenced roadmaps with defined timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and metrics.
Provide executive leadership with clear tradeoff analyses and recommendations on priorities based on organizational capacity and impact.
Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and release planning.
Partner with product leadership to guide technical architecture, build-versus-buy evaluations, platform selection, integration strategy, and delivery for participant and partner platforms.
Establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI adoption in collaboration with cross-functional committees, covering data privacy, security controls, vendor risk management, quality assurance, bias mitigation, and human oversight.
Build the technical foundation for AI readiness, focusing on data quality, system integrations, and scalable infrastructure for feature deployment and experimentation.
Oversee internal IT operations and service delivery, including help desk support, hardware lifecycle management, access controls, onboarding, offboarding, and technical troubleshooting.
Define IT service standards, manage vendor relationships and managed service provider contracts, and lead staff training initiatives to maximize adoption of organizational infrastructure and AI tools.
Oversee the customer relationship management (CRM) platform and associated systems as the operational backbone for programs, development, and reporting.
Direct enterprise data strategy in collaboration with research and evaluation leadership to maintain reliable governance, dashboards, and reporting for program improvement, funding requirements, and executive decision-making.
Implement a consistent project management framework across technology initiatives to maintain accountability, predictability, and cross-functional transparency.
Lead cybersecurity strategy, data protection controls, and operational risk management, maintaining a risk register and presenting mitigations to executive leadership and the Board.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Proven experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing digital products or platforms, including demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence.
Strong program and project delivery discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities in a resource-constrained environment.
Experience with AI implementation, data governance, and enterprise systems.
Demonstrated experience partnering with product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and technical execution.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into actionable decisions for leadership.
Demonstrated commitment to the organization's workforce development mission.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Salesforce CRM platforms.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short-term disability and life insurance; paid parental leave; paid time off; a retirement plan with an employer match; and a remote work schedule.

added.title: Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
Chief Technology Officer | Decision-Grade AI for National Security | Charlotte, NC or Washington, D.C.

We have partnered with a fast-growing AI company in the national security space to find their Chief Technology Officer.

About our client
Most AI is answer-grade: fast, fluent and unaccountable. That works in a chat window, but not in a command post, where the real question is "what would have to be true for this to be wrong?" and a confident wrong answer has real consequences.

Our client builds decision-grade AI instead. Their platform delivers agentic decision support with deterministic workflows, hard data guardrails, and analytic integrity that holds up against people trained to challenge an assessment. It presents competing hypotheses rather than a single confident narrative, and uses graduated authority that knows the difference between advising an analyst and orchestrating an action. It is model-agnostic by design, using frontier intelligence without depending on frontier knowledge, and runs Kubernetes-native from cloud to disconnected edge.

While much of the industry races to make models sound more certain, this team is building a system that makes certainty earn its place. The interface asks the analyst to commit before the machine reveals, nothing leaves the platform without passing an integrity gate, and sometimes the agent's job is to slow you down. It's a distinctive design philosophy with serious engineering behind it, shipped quickly into environments that don't forgive mistakes.

The role
• Lead the technology roadmap while staying hands-on in the codebase, including architecture, reviews and real commits.
• Serve as the company's senior-most technologist and most credible technical voice in the market, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the executive team.
• Be the technical face of the business: customer walkthroughs, partner architecture reviews, conferences, podcasts, and the follow-on conversations where interest turns into procurement. You'll move from a program office to an engineering deep dive in the same afternoon and be at home in both.

What you'll own
• Technical vision and architecture: long-range platform direction across model orchestration, agentic workflow design, data guardrails and evaluation.
• Hands-on engineering: direct contribution to the core platform, architectural spikes, and the hardest technical problems.
• SDLC and security: secure development lifecycle, supply chain integrity, STIG compliance, and ATO pathways into government boundaries.
• Deployment leadership: delivery into GovCloud, air-gapped and disconnected edge environments.
• Customer-facing leadership: technical relationships with mission customers and prime partners, plus writing and defending technical volumes.

About you
• 10+ years as a software engineer who has moved naturally into the AI era.
• AI-native: you build with these tools daily and have clear opinions on where they break.
• Experienced deploying enterprise software into real customer environments, thinking across the full lifecycle: security posture, client-side architecture, environmental constraints and sustainment.
• Proven in client-facing work and ready to take that further as the face of a growing business.
• Comfortable at conferences, on podcasts, on panels and in executive briefings, able to hold technical and business audiences in the same room.
• Precise about claims. You never sell what the code can't do.
• Self-directed and ownership-driven, without needing scaffolding.

Requirements
• 10+ years of professional software engineering.
• Currently hands-on, with a strong background in writing and reviewing code.
• Production experience with LLM-based systems: orchestration, evaluation, retrieval and guardrails.
• Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture (Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD).
• Experience with secure SDLC, threat modelling and government compliance frameworks.
• Ability to lead senior executive and government-level technical discussions.
• US citizenship and eligibility for Top Secret clearance (required).
• Active TS/SCI, AWS GovCloud (IL4/5/6) experience, or prior military/IC service (preferred).

Additional details
• Medical, vision and dental insurance.
• Must be based in Charlotte, NC or Washington, D.C. The role is currently remote, with potential to move to hybrid based on business needs.
• 25 to 35% travel to customer sites, partner facilities and industry events.
• The hiring process includes sharing something you've built (a repository, architecture or technical talk) and a short note on the hardest end-to-end deployment you've owned.

Job Description

Hill International is seeking a Director, Information Technology Solutions to support the Hill Advisory group within the United States.

Hill Advisory helps capital program owners leverage technology to improve program delivery. Our technology services practice specializes in AI-enabled project controls, data governance, BIM and digital twin strategies, PMIS strategy and implementation, geospatial intelligence, and cyber-physical security. We support owners managing complex capital programs across the utilities, energy, aviation, transportation, healthcare, and education sectors.

Responsibilities

Serve as the independent advisor on build, buy, and partner decisions for clients and Hill’s internal technology investments.
Provide objective, evidence-based recommendations, including advising against technology investments when warranted.
Lead technology due diligence for acquisitions, assessing systems, software assets, technical debt, cybersecurity, and integration risks.
Identify technology risks and liabilities that may not surface through traditional financial diligence and advise investment stakeholders accordingly.
Resolve contractual and commercial ambiguity where technology scope is embedded within broader engagements.
Establish clear ownership of scope, budget, decision-making, and change control; escalate unresolved issues as needed.
Define and maintain the technical standards, positions, and recommendations of the Technology Services practice.

Build trusted relationships with regional and sector leaders to expand Technology Services opportunities across Hill.
Own Technology Services pricing strategy, margin performance, and commercial discipline.
Lead, develop, and retain delivery teams and senior client-facing professionals, creating pathways from delivery leadership to business development.
Develop and maintain playbooks, methodologies, engagement templates, pricing standards, and reusable delivery assets.
Represent and advance Hill’s technology advisory services capabilities, strategy, and position across U.S. operations.

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in technology delivery and capital programs, including 5+ years in a client-facing consulting, advisory, or owner's representative role.
Strong knowledge of PMIS platforms, project controls, data governance, and capital program technology ecosystems.
Demonstrated commercial construction of technical scope including experience developing cost models, setting pricing strategies, and negotiating commercial terms with clients.
Independent advisory judgment, including recommending against technology investments when warranted by the analysis.
Ability to translate complex technical decisions into business impacts related to cost, schedule, risk, and operations.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes within a matrixed organization.
Track record of originating, shaping, and closing new business opportunities.
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience leading technology due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, or strategic investments.
Industry expertise within at least one of Hill's key sectors, including utilities, aviation, transportation/transit, healthcare, energy, or large-scale infrastructure programs.
Experience advising executive leadership on technology strategy and investment decisions.
Relevant professional certifications.

Hill International, with more than 4,400+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .

Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.

Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com .

added.title: Software Engineering & Development Lead for Investment Accounting, Vice President, Onsite
added.description:
Who We Are Looking For

State Street is looking for a hands-on Application Engineering Agile Room Lead to provide engineering leadership in the build-out, modernization, and enhancement of a large-scale, business-critical Investment Accounting platform. The candidate will work in a dynamic, fast-paced Agile team environment, partnering closely with business and technology teams across global locations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep experience leading software engineering teams responsible for complex enterprise applications, a strong understanding of financial services and investment accounting workflows, and proven success modernizing large-scale legacy systems. The candidate will help drive the evolution of the platform through modernization initiatives, adoption of contemporary engineering practices, and selective use of cloud capabilities where they deliver measurable business value

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Software Engineering & Development Lead, Vice President you will:

Lead a software engineering team responsible for enhancing and supporting a business-critical portfolio accounting and middle-office application.
Drive the planning and execution of application modernization initiatives, evolving a Windows-based Visual C++ platform toward a modern distributed architecture with web-based user experiences and Java-based services.
Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, architecture, infrastructure, and risk teams to deliver strategic technology solutions aligned with business priorities.
Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable, maintainable, and operationally resilient software solutions.
Oversee solution design, software development, production readiness, and operational stability.
Lead Agile delivery activities, including release planning, estimation, prioritization, and execution across global teams.
Mentor engineering talent and foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation.
Communicate technology strategy, delivery progress, dependencies, and risks to senior leadership.
Evaluate and adopt modern engineering approaches, including AI-assisted development capabilities, automation tooling, and cloud services where appropriate to enhance development efficiency and platform capabilities.

Provide hands-on leadership and support during critical delivery initiatives and complex production challenges.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Strong understanding of investment accounting, portfolio accounting, financial reporting, and related business processes within the financial services industry.
Proven experience delivering technology solutions for financial services organizations, particularly in accounting, investment operations, regulatory reporting, or middle-office platforms.
Extensive experience in enterprise application architecture and distributed systems design.
Strong programming background in Visual C++ and Java, with demonstrated experience modernizing large-scale legacy applications.
Database experience with current Oracle DB versions, including SQL, PL/SQL Development, and other Oracle services/features.
Experience designing and implementing:
Event-driven architectures
Microservices and domain-driven design principles
High-performance and low-latency systems

Strong understanding of transaction processing, reconciliation, data integrity, and accounting-centric system design.
Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems with high throughput and strong reliability requirements.
Working knowledge of Azure cloud services and modern DevOps practices, with an understanding of how cloud technologies can support enterprise application modernization.
Experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar technologies to improve developer productivity, code quality, and software delivery effectiveness.
Strong leadership, collaboration, and communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

These skills will help you succeed in this role

12+ years of experience developing enterprise applications and large-scale data processing solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience working in multi-platform, multi-database, and multi-language application environments.
Experience leading Agile software delivery teams and adhering to SDLC, governance, and risk management processes.
Hands-on experience with modern web technologies, including ReactJS or similar front-end frameworks, as well as microservices concepts, including Spring Boot or similar platform.
Experience designing and delivering enterprise solutions utilizing cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with cloud-native services, CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, application security, and observability practices.
Experience with event-driven architectures, microservices, and service-oriented application design.
Knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, DevSecOps, and AI-assisted development workflows.
Experience within the financial services industry, with exposure to investment accounting, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, or capital markets platforms strongly preferred

Additional Requirements

Regular collaboration with offshore teams in India and China, as well as management and technical teams on the U.S. East Coast, is required.
Demonstrated experience leading, motivating, coaching, and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to build partnerships across business and technology organizations.

Work Requirement

Onsite 2 days a week in office and three days remote
Standard business hours aligned to project and stakeholder needs(8am to 5pm)

Salary Range

$125,000 - $215,000 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home .

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

added.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
added.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world every day. We are deeply committed to the well being of everyone in our global community, and our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

At Snap, our products empower people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. We believe that diverse backgrounds and voices help us create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering at Snap.

What You’ll Do

Lead, manage, and mentor a team of software engineers. Create an environment where people can do their best work, grow their careers, and feel included and supported.
Set the technical vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable goals for a product engineering area aligned to company priorities.
Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Operations, and other Engineering teams to understand customer needs, define product requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver high quality experiences.
Design, implement, and scale critical product components and services across the stack, including backend services, distributed systems, client applications, and data platforms as appropriate for the team.
Drive technical execution across a portfolio of initiatives, from near term product launches to longer term investments in architecture, platform capabilities, and engineering excellence.
Establish a high bar for availability, scalability, performance, privacy, security, operational excellence, and cost management.
Use product and engineering insights to identify opportunities, make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, and improve customer and business outcomes.
Provide technical direction that influences work beyond your immediate team and helps engineering organizations operate more effectively.
Hire, retain, and develop high caliber engineers and leaders while building a diverse and inclusive team.
Communicate clearly with senior leaders and cross functional partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks, decisions, and outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent programming and software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, testing, and technical decision making.
Proven experience building and operating highly available products or services at significant scale.
Experience architecting, designing, and developing distributed systems and modern product experiences.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect technical choices to customer value and business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems, set direction, and lead complex initiatives from strategy through delivery and operation.
Strong collaboration, communication, mentorship, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience developing engineering talent, building effective teams, and fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly and apply them effectively.
Experience with one or more modern programming languages, such as Java, C++, Go, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or JavaScript.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
10+ years of post Bachelor’s software development experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical field plus 9+ years of post graduate software development experience; or a PhD in a related technical field plus 6+ years of post graduate software development experience.
2+ years of experience as an engineering manager or technical leader, including experience setting technical direction for engineering projects or organizations.
Experience architecting, designing, and developing distributed systems and business critical products.
Experience leading, mentoring, and scaling engineering teams to consistently deliver complex, high impact work.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a technical field such as computer science.
Experience building consumer products used at global scale.
Experience partnering with senior executives and management across a globally distributed organization, and exercising sound judgment in a fast changing environment.
Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning to product development, personalization, recommendations, search, or engineering productivity.
A track record of delivering in rapidly changing, highly collaborative, multi site, and multi stakeholder environments.
Ability to create a compelling vision for the future, communicate with clarity, and lead with a collaborative approach.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

Compensation

In the United States, work locations are assigned a pay zone which determines the salary range for the position. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The starting pay may be negotiable within the salary range for the position. These pay zones may be modified in the future.

Zone A (CA, WA, NYC):

The base salary range for this position is $276,000-$414,000 annually.

Zone B:

The base salary range for this position is $262,000-$393,000 annually.

Zone C:

The base salary range for this position is $235,000-$352,000 annually.

This position is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs.
